author: WebBound
description: ixdzs8.com (爱下电子书): book page /read/<id>/. The page lists only the first 80 chapters; the full ToC comes from POST /novel/html bid=<id> (what the 查看完整章节目录 button loads). One page per chapter, text in article.page-content section. Metadata from the selectors. Node fetch gets a 403 bot wall (test:live shows FAIL: HTTP 403); check live in a browser. A plain fetch without cookies or Referer works there, so no Force Hybrid needed.
